post.description:
Find app icons by app name or a description such as purple icons or animal icon. Filter by category or platform. Default sort ranks query matches first. Each call costs 5 credits.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 provider_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

q.description: App name or plain-language description, such as purple icons.

category.description: Case-insensitive category: Books, Business, Development, Education, Entertainment, Finance, Food & Drink, Games, Graphics & Design, Health & Fitness, Lifestyle, Music, Navigation, News, Photo & Video, Productivity, Shopping, Social Networking, Sports, Travel, Utilities, Weather.

platform.description: Case-insensitive platform: iOS, macOS, Windows, watchOS, visionOS.

sort.description:
Featured order, alphabetical or reverse alphabetical. With q, featured means best match first.

Provider reference: allowed values ["featured", "az", "za"]; default "featured".

limit.description:
Icons per page, integer 1 to 100. Defaults to 24.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 24.

offset.description:
Zero-based integer offset for pagination.

Provider reference: minimum 0; default 0.

200.description:
Icon summaries under results, alongside total, limit and offset. Advance offset by limit for the next page.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.
